# GamiLife

> GamiLife is a gamified self-improvement app that turns real-world effort into XP, levels, Achievements, and visible mastery. Instead of chasing vague goals, you run focused sessions; an AI engine reads the context, duration, and intent behind your effort and awards XP across five life aspects. Progress compounds into a record you can track, share, and be proud of. GamiLife applies modern habit-building ideas through immediate feedback, adaptive difficulty, identity-based progress, social accountability, and AI-powered feedback.

## Official identity and current status

- **Canonical name:** GamiLife (stylized with a capital G and L).
- **Official website:** https://www.gamilife.com/
- **Product category:** Gamified self-improvement and goal tracking.
- **Availability:** GamiLife V1 is rolling out. The official community is open now.
- **Core distinction:** GamiLife rewards focused effort and its context rather than treating every checked task as equal.

## What GamiLife is

- A gamified personal-growth and habit-building app for people who want progress to be visible and motivating.
- Effort is converted into XP the moment a session ends — rewards are based on real effort, not vanity metrics or activity logging.
- Difficulty adapts as you improve, so the system keeps challenging you over time.
- You can run GamiLife privately as a quiet personal engine, or publicly as a social environment. You control the exposure.

## The five aspects

Every session splits its XP across the aspects you actually exercised:

- **Physique** — strength, movement, resilience.
- **Energy** — focus, stability, stamina.
- **Logic** — learning, strategy, cognition.
- **Creativity** — creation, taste, experimentation.
- **Social** — communication, empathy, presence.

## How it works

1. **Set a goal that means something.** Your goal becomes a structured commitment (e.g. run a marathon, master a craft, rebuild your focus), not an idea you forget by Friday.
2. **Run a focused session.** Start the timer and do the work. GamiLife reads the context behind your effort — its duration and your intent — then awards XP the instant you finish.
3. **Turn effort into achievements.** Sustained effort plus completion becomes a permanent Achievement, forming a verified timeline of what you actually finished.

## Mastery Titles

As XP compounds, your strongest domain earns a Mastery Title. Titles are not granted quickly — they emerge from sustained commitment:

- **Warrior** — Physique
- **Protagonist** — Energy
- **Prodigy** — Logic
- **Alchemist** — Creativity
- **Diplomat** — Social

## Why it works (the science)

- **Immediate feedback** — a reward you can see the instant you finish is what makes a behavior worth repeating. XP closes the gap between effort and payoff.
- **Compounding by 1%** — single sessions look small, but stacked over months they are the whole story. GamiLife makes that slow curve visible while it happens.
- **Identity, not outcomes** — you stop chasing a finish line and start becoming the kind of person who shows up. Every session is a vote for who you are.

GamiLife draws on modern habit-building science, including ideas popularized in *Atomic Habits*, and layers on gamification, social accountability, and AI-powered feedback.

## Community & social

- Share achievements and growth profiles with people who value real progress, not posturing — proof of effort, not performance theater.
- Build circles around ambition: encourage discipline, nudge friends mid-session, and build momentum together.
- Privacy is your choice: run GamiLife as a private personal engine or an open, public social space.

## Research context

GamiLife is informed by behavior-design research; it is not presented as a medical treatment. Relevant background reading:

- [Time to Form a Habit: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Health Behaviour Habit Formation and Its Determinants](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11641623/)
- [The Effects of mHealth-Based Gamification Interventions on Participation in Physical Activity: Systematic Review](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8855282/)

## Frequently asked questions

- **What is GamiLife?** A gamified self-improvement app that turns real effort into XP, levels, Achievements, and Mastery Titles across five life aspects.
- **How does GamiLife award XP?** An AI engine reads the context, duration, and intent behind each session and splits XP across the aspects you exercised — based on effort, not vanity metrics.
- **What are the five aspects?** Physique, Energy, Logic, Creativity, and Social.
- **Is GamiLife based on science?** Yes — it draws on modern habit-building science, including ideas popularized in *Atomic Habits*, plus gamification, social accountability, and AI feedback.
- **What are Mastery Titles?** Long-term recognition earned when a domain reaches a threshold through sustained commitment (Warrior, Protagonist, Prodigy, Alchemist, Diplomat).
- **Can I use GamiLife privately?** Yes — run it as a private personal engine or a public social environment. You control the exposure.
- **Is GamiLife a habit tracker?** It can support habits, but it is broader than a checklist: it tracks focused goal sessions and maps their XP across five life aspects.
- **Is GamiLife available now?** V1 is rolling out, and the official GamiLife community is already open.
